purpose: Retained currentness episodes for Temporal Constraint rule MaterialStates, preserving revise/retire chronology independently from rule payload history.

columns.name: constraint_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Temporal Constraint whose accepted currentness is described.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Rule MaterialState selected during this currentness episode.
columns.value_contract: Must belong to the same constraint_ref.

columns.name: current_from_at
columns.meaning: Finite instant at which this rule state became the accepted current rule.
columns.value_contract: Finite authoritative mutation instant; forms part of immutable history identity.

columns.name: current_until_at
columns.meaning: Exclusive close instant of this currentness episode, null while open.
columns.value_contract: Null for the sole open episode; once closed it must be finite, greater than current_from_at and cannot be reopened or moved.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_current_history
primary_key.reason: Identify each retained currentness episode for one stable constraint.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_current_history_constraint_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Every episode points to an immutable rule state owned by the same stable Temporal Constraint.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_current_history_interval
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(current_from_at) AND (current_until_at IS NULL OR (isfinite(current_until_at) AND current_until_at > current_from_at))
check_constraints.reason: Require valid finite one-way currentness intervals.

indexes.name: pk_temporal_constraint_current_history
indexes.reason: Constraint history lookup by episode start.

indexes.name: ux_temporal_constraint_current_history_open
indexes.reason: At most one open currentness episode per Temporal Constraint.

indexes.name: ix_temporal_constraint_current_history_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: Reverse history lookup by immutable rule MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_current_history_equivalence
triggers.reason: Require the sole open rule-history episode to equal scoped_current_material_state and enforce insert-open/close-once/no-reopen history lifecycle rules.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Retains accepted-current chronology across immutable rule revisions without modifying prior MaterialState payload.
state_history.current_binding: Exactly one open episode must equal scoped_current_material_state; retirement closes the last episode and leaves no current binding.
state_history.chronology: current_from_at/current_until_at are authoritative currentness chronology; latest inserted rule state is not automatically current.
state_history.immutability_policy: Episode identity and selected MaterialStateRef are immutable; only one-way close from null current_until_at to a valid close instant is allowed.

lifecycle.retention: Retained after revision and retirement to reconstruct accepted currentness history.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement closes the open episode rather than deleting history.

obligations: current binding equals the sole open Temporal Constraint history episode
revision closes exactly the expected old episode and opens the new state
retire closes the last open episode and preserves history
shared current-history dispatcher remains correct for all legacy families
